title: AI wealth is already changing San Francisco's housing market
summary:
Thursday's blockbuster Anthropic (ANT) initial public offering created thousands of new millionaires, and that wealth is already transforming housing markets in San Francisco and the Bay Area.
In three counties where AI companies are particularly concentrated — San Francisco, San Mateo, and Santa Clara — the median homebuyer now makes a 25% down payment, up from a median of 20%-21% from 2020 to 2022.
"Even as rates eased, buyers in some major markets continued to put more money down, which is consistent with AI and tech wealth changing who is buying homes," Realtor.com senior economist Jiayi Xu said in a statement.
